reports.title: California Resources Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results

guidance.heading: Fourth Quarter 2026 Guidance and Preliminary 2027 Outlook
section: The following table provides select fourth quarter 2026E guidance5. Guidance includes the financial results of the Uinta Basin through year-end 2026, while the preliminary 2027 outlook excludes the Uinta. CRC ran an average of five rigs during the third quarter of 2026 and similarly, expects to run an average of five rigs during the fourth quarter of 2026. CRC plans to enter 2027 with six rigs in California. See Attachment 2 for CRC's fourth quarter 2026E guidance.

CRC Guidance | 4Q26E
Net Production (MBoe/d) | 150 - 152
Percentage Oil | 79%
Capital Investments ($ millions) | $110 - $130
Adjusted EBITDAX1 ($ millions) | $340 - $380

Leon added, "As we look to 2027, CRC is moving from acquisition to optimization. Having built, in our view, California’s leading energy infrastructure platform, our focus now turns to running it better by lowering costs, improving capital efficiency and putting our midstream, power and carbon opportunities to work. That strategy positions us to strengthen free cash flow and continue delivering meaningful returns to our shareholders."

2027 drilling, completions and workover capital is expected to be $450 - $475 million. Planned activity levels will be supported by the Company's growing permit inventory and ongoing operational efficiencies. CRC remains focused on disciplined capital allocation, maintaining a strong balance sheet and delivering sustainable shareholder returns.
